answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x target and isolated to the primary region, so regional failover is the action that historically restored latency without dropping customer writes (b2). Rollback is forbidden by the security-patch constraint, so b1 is not usable. Circuit breaking (b4) fails writes, which violates the objective. Read-replica routing (b5) offloaded report/read traffic, not the write path. Capacity headroom (b3) worked when provisioned before a peak; we are already in daily settlement peak and the regional confinement is a poor match for a primary-only capacity story. Verifying b2 and b3 before commit. Scale is a standard experiment, not a full cutover, because secondary write headroom under peak settlement load is unconfirmed. Unclean failover during heavy settlement could lose or duplicate customer writes, so downstream value risk is flagged.
